_comment: Manifest entries outside nightly_matrix.json, run by .github/workflows/regression-extended.yml: weekly always, daily only when the account's Actions queue is idle. Must be manifest names, disjoint from the nightly list.
_pending_note: Manifest entries added 2026-11-12 whose CI verification is still outstanding (cancelled/unrun, or re-calibrated after a first-run failure). Moved into `extended` once a dispatch run passes them.

_excluded.lahgtna-chatterbox-f16: Upstream reproduces it, not a port bug: upstream ChatterboxMultilingualTTS.from_local(oddadmix/lahgtna-chatterbox-v1@6b37e50d, its own conds.pt).generate('الطقس جميل جدا اليوم', language_id='ar') scored through the same cohere-transcribe-arabic-q4_k gives WER 0.75 / 2.5 / 2.0 for seeds 1 / 1234 / 2 ('...اليوم ساعرف ايه اليوم', 'The sun is very beautiful. What's the temperature like?', 'Um, the place is great, just like that.'); the CLI gives WER 4.25 / 1.5 / 1.0 with the GGUF's built-in conds and 0.5 / 1.75 / 1.0 with the upstream conds.pt as voice. Text token ids are identical to the upstream MTLTokenizer ([ar] 721, ...). Control arm tools/ci-heavy/sweep_lahgtna_control.py, heavy-cpu run 44538595767. Original finding: CI run 43186953345.
_excluded.moss-tts-local-v1.5-f16: 9.1 GB F16 model: one-sentence synthesis exceeded 3000 s on the 4-vCPU GH runner (CI run 43186953345) - CPU performance, not a correctness verdict.
_excluded.omniasr-ctc-300m-v2-q4_k: Transcript truncated after the first clause: 'And so my fellow americas ask not.' on samples/jfk.wav (WER 0.73), reproduced locally and in CI run 43170649072, while omniasr-ctc-1b-v2 (same runtime) passes. Open finding.
_excluded.tada-codec: covered by tada-tts-3b-ml, which decodes through the same pinned tada-codec-f16.gguf via --codec-model; tada-ref.gguf in the repo is a voice prompt, not a reference dump, so no standalone stage diff is possible
_excluded.f5-tts-v1-base: synthesis of one sentence exceeds 1200 s on the 4-vCPU GH runner (run 42820528553) - CPU performance issue, not a correctness verdict
_excluded.parakeet-ctc-1.1b-ja-q8_0: Upstream model quality, not a port bug: the upstream NeMo checkpoint (grider-transwithai/parakeet-ctc-1.1b-ja@81b954e9, parakeet-ja-gal.nemo, ASRModel.restore_from().transcribe() as on its model card) produces '…1ッチャーの丘田本は一回戦の飛鳥上獄戦は、、8回6対3302の場面で3人目でバと配こちらはをません' (CER 0.54) on the reazon_baseball fixture, byte-identical to the CrispASR CLI on the F16 GGUF; Q8_0 gives CER 0.51 - control arm tools/ci-heavy/sweep_ja_nemo_control.py, heavy-cpu run 44536398581. Original finding: CI run 44481521499.
_excluded.raon-opentts-1b-f16: 2.8 GB F16 F5-family flow model: one-sentence synthesis exceeded 2400 s on the 4-vCPU GH runner (CI run 44481521499), like f5-tts-v1-base - CPU performance, not a correctness verdict. raon-opentts-0.3b (same runtime) passes.
